creatine-monohydrate.descriptor: The familiar form in strength nutrition.
creatine-monohydrate.description: Creatine monohydrate in a straightforward powder format. An ingredient with a long history in exercise research, presented in a 281 g jar.
creatine-monohydrate.title: Understand the energy behind the effort.
creatine-monohydrate.story: Creatine is part of the system muscles use to replenish ATP, the energy molecule behind contraction. That role is especially relevant to short, intense efforts. Monohydrate is the most widely studied supplemental form—the same form named on this IQON jar. Explore the ingredient science below, then use the final product label for preparation and serving directions.

faqs.question: What does monohydrate mean?
faqs.answer: It identifies a form of creatine with one water molecule associated with each creatine molecule. It is the form used most often in creatine supplementation research.

faqs.question: Is creatine a protein?
faqs.answer: Creatine is a small compound involved in energy metabolism. Protein is made from chains of amino acids. They have different roles, so a creatine powder does not replace dietary protein.

faqs.question: How much should I use?
faqs.answer: Use the directions on the final IQON label. The serving size and amount per serving are still to be published; the 281 g jar weight does not establish a dose.

education.title: Why muscle creatine stores matter.
education.body: Creatine and phosphocreatine help maintain ATP availability during demanding muscle activity. Human research has measured how supplementation changes muscle creatine stores over time. These studies help explain the interest in creatine; their protocols are not directions for this product.
education.scope: Ingredient education. The cited research did not test this IQON product.

sources.label: Hultman et al. · Journal of Applied Physiology, 1996

education.title: What collagen studies actually measure.
education.body: A placebo-controlled trial in 69 women studied a specific collagen hydrolysate over eight weeks. It reported a change in skin elasticity; moisture findings were not statistically significant. The study illustrates why the exact collagen preparation and the outcome measured both matter.
education.scope: Ingredient education. The cited research did not test this IQON product.

That biological role has made NMN a subject of human research. Understanding the pathway is a starting point; the questions a study asks and the preparation it tests determine what its results can tell us.

faqs.question: Are NMN and NAD+ the same molecule?
faqs.answer: They are different molecules. NMN is an intermediate the body can use to make NAD+, which takes part in cellular metabolism.

faqs.question: Is NMN the same as resveratrol?
faqs.answer: They are different compounds. NMN relates to NAD+ biosynthesis; resveratrol is a polyphenol. IQON presents them as separate products.
